_comment: MC normalisation for the 2HDM light-H LHCb-downstream scan (this run). n_gen = number of generated events. sigma values in pb. B and H are the reused BC5 v3.6 samples (copied verbatim, sha256 in provenance_reused.json); inel is the NEW Pythia 8.316 SoftQCD:inelastic pi/K sample generated in this run (work/magnus/samples/minbias_pik.txt.gz).

B.role: B+-/B0 (B_s, B_c rows must be dropped by the consumer) from pp -> b bbar, reweighted per-exclusive-channel to Br(B->X_s H)
B.sigma_note: 560 ub total pp -> b bbar at 13 TeV (BC5 v3.6 value: LHCb PRL 118,052002 144+-21 ub in 2<eta<5 divided by the 0.2541 fraction measured in this sample; the 7 TeV check reproduces ~290 ub). 1 ub = 1e6 pb.

inel.role: inelastic pp 13 TeV -> pi+-, K+-, K0/K0bar fragmentation hadrons at status 91/92 (no eta cut); consumer takes pi+- for pi->H e nu and K+-,K0/K0bar for K->pi H + K->H e nu
inel.sigma_note: inelastic pp cross section 79.5 mb (measured normalisation, as in BC5); Pythia sigmaGen is recorded separately in the job summary and in logs/samples.md
inel.sigmaGen_vs_normalisation_note: Pythia LO sigmaGen = 78.05 mb, the normalisation uses the measured 79.5 mb (DESIGN 4); the 1.8 % difference is recorded here, not corrected, because it affects a channel that is ~1e-4 of the signal.
inel.format_note: 10 columns: event pdg px py pz E x y z t (x,y,z in mm, t in mm/c); pdg in {211,-211,321,-321,311,-311}; status 91/92 fragmentation hadrons, no eta cut; K0/K0bar are flavour states -> consumer applies the 50/50 K_L/K_S treatment of DESIGN 3.3

H.role: SM Higgs (status 62 pre-decay copy, 11 columns) reweighted per process to the 2HDM h production mixture; h->HH split into two H
H.sigma_note: sum of 13 TeV SM Higgs production cross sections [pb] (HXSWG, as BC5); reweighted per process to the 2HDM mixture

hadron_lib_note: work/magnus/hadron_lib/hadron_lib_{gg,ss,cc,tautau}.txt.gz; the 'tau' CHANNEL of the decay module maps to file channel 'tautau' (bc5_lib _LIB_MAP).

hadron_lib_info.note: generated on the exact per-channel subsets of work/analysis/grids/mass_grid.txt; all 71 open-channel (scan mass, channel) pairs have a node within the 0.6 % consumer tolerance (work/magnus/validation_interface.json); the consumer rotates each event by a random SO(3) matrix as in bc5_lib.HadronLib.
